hero.title: We design the digital systems that move
hero.intro: Websites, business applications, and useful automations, built with rigor for Quebec's small and medium businesses.
hero.diagramAlt: Abstract diagram representing a connected digital ecosystem

valueProp.title: Technology should simplify your operations — never complicate them.
valueProp.text: We bring strategy, design, and development into a single process to deliver tools that are understandable, high-performing, and genuinely useful.

whyUs.title: Clarity
whyUs.text: Every recommendation explains the need it solves; every budget line is itemized, with no technical line left unexplained.

whyUs.title: Technical quality
whyUs.text: Automatically tested code, reviewed before delivery, on an architecture built to evolve without a full rebuild.

whyUs.title: Closeness
whyUs.text: Direct exchange with the person who designs and builds — no sales layer between you and the code.

whyUs.title: Useful innovation
whyUs.text: AI and automation are added only when they reduce a specific, identified repetitive task — never for the sake of a demo.

servicesSection.title: Expertise focused on your digital challenges.

processSection.title: Five steps. A clear path from the need to going live.

process.title: Understand
process.text: We clarify your goals, constraints, users, and business priorities.

process.title: Structure
process.text: We propose a simple architecture, a realistic scope, and a delivery plan.

process.title: Design
process.text: We create the interfaces, content, and journeys with strong attention to conversion.

process.title: Develop
process.text: We build cleanly, test on mobile, and optimize performance, SEO, and accessibility.

process.title: Support
process.text: We document, deploy, and stay available for adjustments and future evolution.

concepts.title: Projects built to solve concrete problems.

expertise.title: Modern choices, explained without unnecessary jargon.
expertise.text: We favor a lean, secure, and maintainable architecture. Each technology answers a specific need rather than following a trend — and each one is used in at least one real project.
expertise.securityText: Access, data, and deployment considered from the architecture stage onward.
expertise.qualityText: Testing, performance, and accessibility built into delivery.

categories.title: Web & Frontend
categories.text: Fast, responsive, accessible interfaces, built to stay maintainable as they evolve.

categories.title: Mobile applications
categories.text: iOS and Android apps from a single codebase, with authentication and synchronized data.

categories.title: Backend & data
categories.text: Relational databases and APIs built for security, data consistency, and the product's future growth.

categories.title: Infrastructure & deployment
categories.text: Documented, reproducible Linux hosting, with per-service isolation and a reverse proxy.

categories.title: DevOps, quality & observability
categories.text: Automated tests and continuous integration to catch regressions before launch.

categories.title: Automation & AI
categories.text: Targeted API integrations and automations, used only when they reduce an identified repetitive task.

cta.title: Let's turn your next digital challenge into a useful system.
cta.text: Share the need and the priorities so Infotechs Solutions can review your request.
